services.desc: Enjoy our frequently updated Deale fishing reports taken directly from our Maryland charter fishing trips aboard the Ebb Tide. Even the most professional angler tries to get the latest fishing report for the region he will be fishing. Anglers and Captains alike all want to know where the hot bite is. A Deale fishing report like a weather report is just another tool to help you have a successful day on the water. These reports come directly from Captain Billy and his daily deep sea sport fishing trips off Deale. You may not see a report everyday but a weekly or biweekly wrap up is a good bet. If you were a customer aboard the Ebb Tide you may even find your name and picture in the Captain’s

blurb: Guests fish for Striped Bass and other species on the middle Chesapeake Bay from mid-April through December. The operator provides safe and enjoyable offshore fishing adventures with guidance for newcomers. The business operates from two locations: Happy Harbor Inn in Deale and Podickory Point in Annapolis.
